summary: 数据指标卡：大数字指标与标签的展示卡片
expected: 指标卡组件，展示大号数字（展示字体）、单位后缀与说明标签，可选趋势/脚注，2-4 列自适应
acceptanceCriteria: 数字层级用展示字体且深浅主题下均有正确对比度
标签、脚注与数字的排版层级明确
卡片材质与 UiSurface Glass 契约一致

consumers.scenario: 技术分享中的关键数据/指标展示

resolution: Accepted 2026-10-13. UiStatCard, shared CSS and public Vue types are implemented; Vue unit tests 70/70 passed. tests/visual/presentation-data.spec.ts passes desktop/mobile light/dark/system snapshots with 2-4 metrics and narrow/long-text layouts. Real consumer: Neoverse-Slides/packages/slidev-theme-neoverse/layouts/stats.vue and slides/tech-share-template/slides.md slide 8. Consumer presentation-data checks passed 12/12 in dev and 12/12 in production; full Slides build/output validation passed; luna/max reviewed real consumer screenshots. Publication is separate.
